data.toggleOffIfActive: Pressing the active input switch turns the receiver off

data_description.input_switches: Choose up to five inputs to display as separate switches.
data_description.toggleOffIfActive: Pressing an already active input turns the receiver off (only for inputs created as separate switches).
data_description.hidden_zone_inputs: Select inputs to omit from zone TVs. The main receiver keeps all inputs.

data.toggleListeningModeLink: Group listening mode switch with receiver
data.listelingmodesAsTV: Additional TV entity with listening modes as inputs
data.onlyLearnedListeningModes: Offer learned listening modes after ten are confirmed

data_description.toggleListeningMode: Create the additional Audio switch for toggling between listening modes.
data_description.toggleListeningModeLink: Links the listening mode switch to the main TV in the Pioneer bridge when the TV is enabled and the additional entities are not shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.listeningMode: Choose the primary listening mode (default 0013). With fewer than ten learned modes, all known modes are offered; some may not work on this receiver.
data_description.listeningModeOther: Choose the alternate listening mode (default 0112). With fewer than ten learned modes, all known modes are offered.
data_description.listeningModeFallback: Choose the fallback mode (default 0101). With fewer than ten learned modes, all known modes are offered.
data_description.listelingmodesAsTV: Creates a separate HomeKit TV for listening modes. Select its channels in Apple Home; no additional TV appears in Home Assistant.
data_description.onlyLearnedListeningModes: After ten confirmed modes, this option limits the receiver sound mode in Home Assistant to confirmed modes and defaults. The HomeKit TV still offers all modes for manual channel selection. Save and reopen settings to refresh the three selectors.
data_description.resetListeningModes: Clears automatically learned modes once when saved. Manual HomeKit channel visibility is preserved.
data_description.excluded_listening_modes: A mode is excluded automatically after two E06 responses. You can also exclude modes here or clear their selection to restore them. Excluded modes are omitted in Home Assistant; their Apple Home channels remain available but hidden.

data.homekitLinkedVolume: Create HomeKit TV with linked volume light
data.volumeAsLight: Also expose volume as a light
data.additionalEntitiesInHa: Show additional entities in Home Assistant and use HomeKit Bridge

data_description.homekitLinkedVolume: Creates a TV with an integrated volume light in the shared Pioneer bridge. Its QR code appears in a notification. Exclude the normal receiver media player from HA HomeKit Bridge to prevent a duplicate.
data_description.volumeAsLight: Creates a standalone volume light. The new checkbox determines whether it appears in Home Assistant or directly in the shared Pioneer bridge.
data_description.additionalEntitiesInHa: Separate input switches, the standalone volume light, and the listening mode switch appear in Home Assistant and can be exposed through HomeKit Bridge. When disabled, they appear only in the shared Pioneer HomeKit bridge.

data_description.minVolume: Lower limit for the separate volume light (0–100); its slider maps this value to 0%.
data_description.maxVolume: Upper limit for the separate volume light (0–100); its slider maps this value to 100%.
data_description.zoneControl: Probe zones 2 and 3. Supported zones appear as a separate TV entity, power switch, and volume light.

data.mcaccControl: MCACC as a separate TV device

data_description.audioInfo: Read audio status with ?AST over Telnet.
data_description.videoInfo: Read video status with ?VST over Telnet.
data_description.toneControls: Create a tone switch and bass/treble sliders when supported.
data_description.mcaccControl: Creates a separate HomeKit TV with MCACC memories 1 through 6 as selectable channels. No additional TV appears in Home Assistant.
data_description.phaseControl: Create a separate TV device with Off, On and Full Band as channels when supported.
data_description.virtualSurroundBack: Create a switch when ?VSB is supported.
data_description.channelLevels: Show only speaker channels that reply to their level query.
data_description.tunerControl: Frequency and preset plus band, class and up/down buttons when supported.
data_description.hidden_mcacc_memories: Select MCACC memories to omit from the TV.

data.maxReconnectAttemptsBeforeDiscover: Rediscover after this many reconnection attempts
data.telnetSwitchInHa: Telnet connection switch in Home Assistant

data_description.telnetSwitch: Create a switch for the Telnet connection. After the receiver is turned off, the connection stays open for the period specified directly below.
data_description.maxReconnectAttempts: Maximum number of connection attempts before giving up.
data_description.maxReconnectAttemptsBeforeDiscover: Search for the receiver again after this many failed connection attempts.
data_description.sendKeepAliveTimeoutMinutes: How long the Telnet connection stays active after the receiver is switched off, in minutes.
data_description.telnetSwitchInHa: Enabled: Show the Telnet connection switch in Home Assistant. Disabled: Show it only in the shared Pioneer HomeKit bridge.
